notes.title: Game Update 1.1.0 - Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We have a fresh batch of fixes so you can keep dashing and swinging smoothly. Hope you enjoy it!

Corrections and Enhancements:

 Camera Fix: The camera no longer shakes upon death, providing a smoother experience for the player. The camera now properly adjusts when the player exits the screen, ensuring a more seamless transition.
 Visual Adjustments: Background color intensity in the stages has been fine-tuned to improve the overall aesthetic of the game.
 Audio Fix: Sound effects volume has been adjusted, including the gravity modifier, for a more balanced auditory experience.
 Gameplay Enhancement: Projectiles are now removed upon restarting the stage, preventing undesired situations.
 Completion Indicators: Upon completing a stage, there are now clear indicators showing the world and stage the player has reached.
 Visible Durability: Durability indicators have been added for breakable platforms, providing players with crucial information during gameplay.
 Time Correction: Fixed timing issues in World 3, Secret 1, ensuring consistent gaming experience.


We appreciate your ongoing support and feedback! Enjoy playing the updated and improved version of Dash & Swing!
